The domestic quotations of antimony ingot (2#) and antimony oxide (99.5%) were mainly maintained at 67,000-68,000yuan/t and 60,000-62,000yuan/t, seeing small scale of decrease compared with that in 2012. After New Year Holidays, inquires in antimony ingot market started to increase. However, transactions didn’t see large improvement. Currently, traders asking for quotation aim at confirm the current price of antimony ingot rather than having purchase intention. Before the end of 2012, most of suppliers reduced price to de-stock the current stock. Spring Festival is coming. Although the demand is weak, suppliers would not like to cut price to sell products when having no large stock and capital pressure. The price of antimony ingot (2#) is strong and the price of antimony oxide is maintained at 61,000-62,000yuan/t (ex-work price). At present, most of customers still replenish stock in accordance with demand. In the past one month, the watching attitude kept thick in the antimony oxide market. Therefore, transaction

s in spot goods market were few. At the end of January, many suppliers suspended quotation to prepare for Spring Festival, and transactions of antimony ingot and antimony oxide in spot goods market were not active. In accordance with quotation collected by Antaike, the quotation of antimony ingot (2#) was maintained at 67,000-68,000yuan/t in January. Some producers have suspended production and carry out maintenance. The operation rate was low. Seen from enterprises in Lengshuijiang City, Hunan Province, the newly added output was limited. Meanwhile, the stock level saw obvious decreased compared with that in 2012. The supply in Yunnan and Guangxi didn’t see large change. Therefore, the general supply of antimony in January is in low level. Seen from the current market situation, the domestic demand from down-stream antimony consumption enterprises remained weak. In order to avoid price dropping, most of purchasers held watching attitude. The demand for antimony oxide was low, and customers have weak intention to purchase products. Currently, the global and domestic market maintains the method that buying products for instant consumption. The sales will be kept in low level in short term. Therefore, seen from the current supply and demand, the antimony market will stay in stagnant, and it remains not clear whether the market will resume in the first quarter. Output In accordance with statistics released by CNIA, Chinese output of antimony products in the December 2012 was about 35.8kt, up 21.23% y-o-y. In Dec., the export of antimony products was 5,828t, up by 79.60% m-o-m, and the total export of antimony products in Jan.-Dec. was 50.4kt, up by 5.63% y-o-y, while the metal content was 44.2kt, up by 7.52% y-o-y. ##### **Outlook** Since the New Year, both the global and domestic market demand has been weak, and the general antimony market has been in stagnant. The Spring Festival is coming, participants in antimony market are leaving the market. It is hoped that the market may turn better after the holiday. It is predicted that transactions in the following one month will tend to be sluggish. Currently, the domestic supply of antimony products is sufficient. Purchase activity didn’t see obvious growth as before, and suppliers have no profit to obtain. Weak demand put large pressure on antimony products prices. Suppliers commonly hope the market could become well after Spring Festival. Antaike predicts that transactions in antimony market after Spring Festival will be more active, which will support antimony price to see small scale of rebound. However, whether the growth will keep for long is not confirmed, because the down-stream demand is the determination factor. Website: www.antaike.com 4 Minor Metals Monthly No.155 Seen from the current demand, it is difficult for the antimony price to see growth, but due to short supply of antimony concentrate, the price of antimony ingot is also hard to drop. Antaike believes under the circumstance of slow operation of the market

, it is very important to control domestic antimony supply. It is estimated that the antimony market in the first quarter of 2013 will fluctuate in small scale and high level. The average price of domestic antimony ingot (99.65%) in the first quarter will be around 69,000yuan/t.

#### **Chinese cobalt supply falls by 12.62% y-o-y in 2012** 

Import of Chinese accumulated cobalt ores & conc. fell by 49.28% y-o-y to 176,609t; import of intermediate products of cobalt wet-processing metallurgy rose by 30.04% y-o-y to 72,702t; import of alliage blanc rose by 20.48% y-o-y to 8,189t; cobalt supply in 2012 is estimated to be 37.4kt (including import cobalt and recyclable cobalt), down by 12.62% compared with 42.8kt in 2011. 

##### **Chinese Cobalt Supply 2008-2012** 



_Source: Antaike_ 

#### **Cobalt consumption in PTA industry ups by 23.6% in 2012** 

Chinese PTA new added capacity increased by 61%, to 1,250 and its total capacity approached to 33Mtpy. According to statistics, average PTA operation rate in 2012 was about 73%, real output reached about 20Mt from 16.45Mt in 2011. Cobalt acetate consumption was about 4,600t while cobalt consumption rose by 23.6% to 11Mt. 

PTA is likely to expand rapidly and its new added capacity will reach 6.5Mtpy. Thus total capacity will reach above 39Mtpy and cobalt consumption will have a continuous increase. 

#### **Output of high temperature alloy and high speed tool steel dropped** 

Output of high temperature alloy and high speed tool steel dropped in 2012. According to the statistics from Stainless Council of China Special Steel Enterprises Association Chinese high temperature alloy crude steel output dropped by 13.65% y-o-y to 8,259t; high speed tool crude steel output dropped by 19.42% y-o-y to 77,230t. The output fall is the main reason of cobalt consumption decline in high temperature alloy and high speed tool steel industries.

#### **Export** 

Export of lithium cobalt oxide in 2012 increased by 49.71% y-o-y to 6,773t. So far more and more foreign battery producers develop upstream products in China such as lithium cobalt oxide and ternary precursor. 

Export of refined cobalt increased by 11.05% y-o-y to 3,227t in 2012; export of cobalt powder dropped by 11.64% y-o-y to 562t; export of cobalt salt increased by 41.34% y-o-y to 5,563t, of which, export of cobalt tetroxide increased by 72.64% y-o-y to 4,178t. 

The increasing export was mainly due to weak market in 2012. Meanwhile domestic smelters were willing to export products and the payment term for foreign customers was short, thus enterprises could return payment on time. 

#### **Outlook** 

As China entered tradition Spring Festival holiday in Feb., transaction on Chinese market was limited and global cobalt price kept steady; after holiday, cobalt price is likely to increase because players return back to cobalt market and start preparing stocks. 

# **<u>Indium Market Overview</u>** 

The indium consumption is expected to become better in 2013, and the long term contracts encouraged the overseas indium prices. The foreign refined indium ingot quotation increased to US$ 510-550/kg from US$ 460-530/kg in January, up by 7.58%. Besides, there was a rumor said an operation in South Korea suspended production, which made market participators worry about the supply and led to a raise of the price. Then, the rumor was denied by insiders. 

The domestic indium quotation was active on the stimulation of overseas market. The domestic refined indium quotation offered by Indium Branch of CNIA increased by RMB 85/kg or 2.47% to RMB 3,500-3,550/kg by the end of February from RMB 3,400-3,480/kg at the beginning of the month. The crude indium quotation climbed by RMB 95/

kg or 3.03% to RMB 3,200-3,270/kg at the end of January. The refined indium FOB quotation was US$ 510-560/kg, up by US$ 45/kg or 9.18% against the beginning of the month.

##### **Indium products quotation by Indium, Bismuth & Germanium Branch of CNIA** 

The domestic and overseas indium markets represented different view in 2012. Affected by the weak economic environment, the global indium market was struck, while the price was in downtrend during the year. In Domestic market, the indium production declined on the weak demand from foreign users. But, the Chinese indium price was stronger than that in overseas market on financing demand, active transaction and state reserves. As a result, the import quantity increased. 

The unbalance of development of Chinese indium industrial structure affected the domestic indium market in 2012 too, which would not be changed too much in 2013. Accordingly, the indium demand will be still soft in 2013, and it will be still hard to export. The domestic indium stock was concentrated primarily in 2012, which will be concentrated further in 2013. Generally, the domestic indium prices will be in uptrend slowly this year, and there will be still big stress. 

The global electronic sector was influenced by the European debt crisis in 2012. The trade quantity between key indium importing and exporting countries shrank a lot. Japan imported 157 tonnes of indium in Jan.-Nov., 2012, down by 66.3% y-o-y; South Korea imported 89.6 tonnes, and exported 140.1 tonnes in the same period, down by 35.3% and 34.5%, respectively; the United States imported 101 tonnes in the first 11months, down by 27.6%. 

Japan imported 8.3 tonnes of indium from China in Jan.-Nov., down by 93% y-o-y; the proportion in all import declined to 5.3% from 25.3%. Meanwhile, South Korea imported 30.3 tonnes of indium from China, down by 64.6%; the proportion declined to 33.8% from 61.95%. The United States imported 14.8 tonnes from China, down by 69.2%; the proportion decreased to 14.6% from 34.4%. 

The Japanese and Taiwan ITO target manufacturers basically operated in lower than 70% rate in 2012. The other downstream fields like LED and thin-film solar cell sectors suffered hard time too. The global consumption declined quantity was more than previous anticipation in 2012. In

Due to the difference between domestic and overseas prices, the import increased in 2012, while the regular export shrank. On the contrary, the smuggling movement became more in the year. 

According to the China Customs, China imported 30,897 kg of indium in 2012, up by 319.3% y-o-y. Meanwhile, the export declined by 95.7% to 4,599 kg. As one of the world key indium supplier, China created a low record of export in 2012.

##### **Chinese Indium export in 2003-2012** Chinese zinc output declined by 200kt at least in 2012 compared with the previous year meanly from key producers, which affected the indium production. However, there were some new producers started produce indium, which contributed output. The nation’s total refined indium output declined by 9 tonnes y-o-y to 383 tonnes in 2012, according to initial statistics made by the Indium, Bismuth & Germanium Branch of CNIA. The output in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region slipped down obviously affected by the cadmium pollution accident in 2012; Jiangsu Province is a key processing region with supplied raw material, which ‘s output declined too; the production in Hunan Province maintained unchanged basically; that in Yunnan, Shaanxi and Henan increased because of the commission of new operations. Indium was trade actively in Wuxi Stainless Steel Exchange and Pan Asia Gold Exchange in 2012, which absorbed a big quantity of stocks from producers. Moreover, The State Reserve Bureau of China built 80 tonnes of refined indium stockpile in 2012, which was mostly delivered before the end of 2012. The net import of indium was 19.7 tonnes in 2012, while the domestic consumption was about 60 tonnes. Accordingly, over 85% of indium output turned to domestic stocks in 2012. The Indium, Bismuth & Germanium Branch of CNIA learns that among all domestic refined indium stocks (excluding state owned reserves), 1/3 was held by producers; 1/3 was in exchanged’ warehouses or individuals; and the rest 1/3 was held by investors. Antaike estimates Chinese refined zinc output will be 5 Mt in 2013, up by 3.5% y-o-y. As a byproduct of zinc, indium output will increase following zinc. But, the producers’ activity will be Website: www.antaike.com 10 Minor Metals Monthly No.155 affected by the high stocks and low price, and the growth quantity will be limited. The macro economic environment is prospected to be better in 2013, which will fuel up the indium demand. The downstream ITO target, LED, thin-film solar cell and alloys sectors will resume in the new year, which may raise the export. The investment oriented demand was strong in 2012, which will decrease in 2013. Then, the support from investment activity will be an uncertainty for indium price. Meanwhile, it is a factor that the domestic indium stocks rank in high level, while the smuggling activity with lower price will be still frequent. The indium price will face big pressures in 2013.
